name: mycosts
description: Scripts da raiz: dev sobe back e front juntos; em producao o back serve o front buildado (render.yaml).

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n back,front -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
